# FoundrySignal

> FoundrySignal is the intelligence layer for onchain venture capital: discover early-stage Solana ventures, investigate founders, trace shipped software, and read every claim against its original evidence. Research first — not speculation. Operated from Dubai, United Arab Emirates.

FoundrySignal is a research and information service, not investment advice, not a broker-dealer or exchange, not a custodian, and not a token launchpad. Trading execution is deliberately disabled behind four independent review gates.

- [Home](https://foundrysignal.aiazimara.com/): Overview of the platform and the evidence-graph differentiator.
- [Product](https://foundrysignal.aiazimara.com/product): Venture dossiers, founder intelligence, repository intelligence, AI analyst.
- [Methodology](https://foundrysignal.aiazimara.com/methodology): How data is collected, verified, classified and aged — plus the FAQ.
- [Evidence](https://foundrysignal.aiazimara.com/evidence): Claims, immutable SHA-256 source snapshots, computed verification statuses, disputes.

- [Pricing](https://foundrysignal.aiazimara.com/pricing): Explorer, Researcher, Professional, Team, Enterprise — plans are configuration data.

## Evidence classification (computed, never asserted)

- INDEPENDENTLY_CORROBORATED: two or more independent source types agree.
- SOURCE_CONFIRMED: one authoritative provider observation.
- SELF_ASSERTED: the venture's own material.
- FOUNDER_PROVIDED: issuer workflow input, labeled and never trust-upgrading.
- DISPUTED: contradicting evidence exists.
- STALE: past its freshness policy.
- UNKNOWN: no linked evidence.

## Key facts

- Primary chain: Solana (onchain reads via @solana/kit, slot-level provenance, read-only).
- Market data: Jupiter public APIs, asOf timestamps; quote previews only.
- Trading execution: DISABLED — requires product, legal/jurisdiction, provider-integration and security review gates plus an execution kill switch and operator env flag.
- Data collection: server-side provider adapters only; every observation carries provider, timestamps and a SHA-256 content hash.
- AI analyst: answers cite collected evidence records validated server-side; missing evidence returns explicit "insufficient evidence".
- Location: Dubai, United Arab Emirates; global research audience.
